property_summary: After funding the contract with 1 ether, calling withdrawAll(recipient) by the owner, the reference sends the full balance (making the contract balance 0), while the bug sends 0 ether (leaving the contract non-zero). The assertion checks address(c).balance == 0.
change_summary: Replace the transfer statement with payable(_recipient).transfer(0) to send zero ether instead of the full balance.
